scope: Settings package v3: resolve A-PI (all-signatures-inventory FLAG-3, SINI:1497-1557 ProcessInternal/ProcessLocalScriptFunction built-in derivation init-time code reads) via ini keys, re-verify through the v2 oracles.

claims.claim: The exact ini keys controlling the derivation are [Hooks] HookProcessInternal and [Hooks] HookProcessLocalScriptFunction (SettingsManager.cpp:279-280 REGISTER_BOOL_SETTING -> parser.get_bool('Hooks', key); consumed at UE4SSProgram.cpp:1075-1076 into UnrealConfig.bHookProcessInternal/bHookProcessLocalScriptFunction). ScanOverrides.process_internal / process_local_script_function (SINI:1508/1516 sub-gates) are NOT ini-reachable (zero references in SettingsManager.cpp) - they are programmatic lambdas only (UE4SSProgram.cpp:868 sets version_finder). Therefore the ONLY ini way to skip the 164-byte Zydis read is making the outer gate false: BOTH keys must be 0, because SINI:1497 is an OR and the PLSF sub-derivation at SINI:1516 does not consult bHookProcessLocalScriptFunction.

Setting both keys to 0 does NOT kill the Lua event path; it only skips the built-in PI/PLSF derivation + detour install. ProcessEvent resolution is a separate PostInitialize step (SINI:1448-1456) gated by its own key [Hooks] HookUObjectProcessEvent (default true, untouched) and resolved from the vtable via OPTIONAL_GET_ADDRESS_OF_UNREAL_VIRTUAL - a data read, no Zydis text read. ExecuteInGameThread drains via engine_tick_hook (HookEngineTick=true untouched) with a cross-fallback to ProcessEvent mode (worker-engine-tick-fallback REPORT). RegisterKeyBind is independent. Failure mode of the skipped block is warning-only: UE4SSProgram.cpp:1148-1165 sets can_create_custom_events=false and logs; nothing throws. Package Lua (TownfallItemSpawner main.lua + shared UEHelpers.lua) uses zero RegisterHook and no custom events, so no consumer of PI/PLSF exists in this package.
claims.evidence: staged UnrealInitializer.cpp:1448-1456,1497-1558; UE4SSProgram.cpp:1148-1165; package-v2 Lua grep; worker-engine-tick-fallback/REPORT.md

claims.claim: Key inclusion is NOT conditional on the pending exec-writability verdict (worker-exec-writability/ is empty - no verdict landed). Under exec-only/unreadable text the defaults FAULT at SINI:1506 (ASM::resolve_function_address_from_potential_jmp -> get_first_instruction_at_address reads instruction bytes at the ExecuteUbergraph FuncPtr; ASMHelper.cpp:49-69, no null short-circuit) before the 164-byte loop - keys=false removes that unconditional init-time read. Under readable text the keys are behavior-neutral for this package and additionally avoid the FLAG-1-class on-demand detour WRITE against text (inventory E5). So ONE package ships; the two-package v3-safe-now/v3-conditional split is unnecessary and would imply a hazard that the code does not support.
claims.evidence: ASMHelper.cpp:49-69; SIGNATURES-INVENTORY.md C10/E5 rows; empty worker-exec-writability/; staged UnrealInitializer.cpp:1505-1506
